summary: End-to-end backend + frontend regression for centralized selected-location, real Open-Meteo weather, persona-aware recommendations, 24h modal, weekday 7-day forecast, map, theme switching, and mobile layout. 11/11 backend pytest cases pass; all critical frontend flows pass with zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined AFTER it is referenced inside /api/locations and /api/weather exception handlers. If an exception fires at import/startup time before logging.basicConfig runs, the NameError would mask the original error. Move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` above the route handlers.
weather_service._forecast_cache is a process-level dict without size cap; consider capping entries or using functools.lru_cache-style eviction to avoid unbounded growth over long uptimes.
